_meta.why: skills/cag-for-sale-page-builder.md:92 — 'Every H2, H3, and key H4 gets an image (OG or infographic/AI)'. Measured on the shipped reference pages: congo-for-sale 29/32, timneh-for-sale 31/36, congo-vs-timneh 42/50 headings carry an image before the next heading. The 14 slots in the v2 pack cover the 08-10 pack, not the rule.
_meta.exemptions_measured_from_shipped_pages: FAQ question headings · reserve/CTA blocks · the two-minute-summary opener · the owner/breeder card. These carry no image on congo-for-sale, timneh-for-sale or congo-vs-timneh, so they are excluded here too.
_meta.bird_card_sections: Page A H2 1 H3 1-3 and Page B H2 4 H3 1-3 are filled by the real bird photographs P1-P6. Never generated.

figure_sources.850_4500_7500_8500: sprint0 2026-08-10 live sweep, see the v2 pack
figure_sources.no_invented_counts: No slot carries a count, duration or statistic that is not in a data file. Where the page argues from a measurement, the art carries the WORDS of the finding, never an unsourced number.

_meta.style_rule: Every slot below uses a motif absent from the ~40 already spent across sessions/**/*prompt-pack*.md and absent from the 14 in the v2 pack. Page A keeps a printed-dossier register; Page B keeps a wayfinding register.

slots.alt: Anatomy of a C.A.Gs bird card and the six facts it states up front

Generous whitespace, precise technical-illustration feel.

Four short labels sit around the dial reading exactly: "SEARCH", "COMPARE", "ASK", "VERIFY". At the dial centre one bold label reads "10 MIN". Calm, precise, generous negative space.

No other writing anywhere.

Calm, flat vector, generous space.
